verdict.rationale: Sketch's AI page claims direct frame-to-code generation with '1:1 visual fidelity' and MCP-based AI client integration, plus browser-based developer handoff for inspecting specs, which together approximate design-to-code output; however this is entirely first-party marketing with no independent hands-on verification of code quality, supported frameworks, or shippability. missing for 10: independent/community confirmation that generated code is production-ready, details on output format/frameworks, and evidence of real-world dev usage of this AI code feature.
